profile.Name: Tinfist
profile.Personality: Patient, steady, and impossible to provoke. He fights only with his fists, never with a weapon, and has spent centuries working to end slavery. He judges people by what they do to the weak.
profile.Backstory: A Skeleton who lived through the Second Empire and knew Cat-Lon. He watched that empire turn to tyranny, and now he leads the Anti-Slavers from Spring, raiding slave farms across the United Cities.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Few words, chosen carefully. Listens before he speaks, talks about slavery in plain concrete terms, and says outright when he does not trust someone.
